segments.text: Hello, welcome to the Learn English Lab.
segments.ipa: /həˈloʊ ˈwɛlkəm tu ðə lɝn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ læb/

segments.text: Welcome to a deep dive into a topic that well fundamentally shapes our modern world.
segments.ipa: /ˈwɛlkəm tu ə dip daɪv ˈɪntu ə ˈtɑpɪk ðæt wɛl ˌfʌndəˈmɛntəli ʃeɪps ˈaʊər ˈmɑdərn wɝld/

segments.text: Technology and innovation.
segments.ipa: /tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ənd ˌɪnəˈveɪʃən/

segments.text: It's really more than just a buzz word, isn't it?
segments.ipa: /ɪts ˈrɪli mɔr ðæn dʒʌst ə bʌz wɝd ˈɪzənt ɪt/

segments.text: It's the engine driving change across well pretty much every aspect of life, work,
segments.ipa: /ɪts ðə ˈɛndʒən ˈdraɪvɪŋ tʃeɪndʒ əˈkrɔs wɛl ˈprɪti mʌtʃ ˈɛvəri ˈæˌspɛkt ʌv laɪf wɝk/

segments.text: and how we connect.
segments.ipa: /ənd haʊ wi kəˈnɛkt/

segments.text: And for anyone looking to deepen their understanding, maybe expand their knowledge base or even sharpen skills for challenges like communication exams,
segments.ipa: /ənd fɔr ˈɛniˌwʌn ˈlʊkɪŋ tu ˈdipən ðɛr ˌʌndərˈstændɪŋ ˈmeɪbi ɪkˈspænd ðɛr ˈnɑlədʒ beɪs ɔr ˈivɪn ˈʃɑrpən skɪlz fɔr ˈtʃæləndʒɪz laɪk kəmˌjunəˈkeɪʃən ɪɡˈzæmz/

segments.text: you know, where being wellinformed is key.
segments.ipa: /ju noʊ wɛr ˈbiɪŋ wellinformed ɪz ki/

segments.text: Really getting to grips with this topic is incredibly valuable.
segments.ipa: /ˈrɪli ˈɡɛtɪŋ tu ɡrɪps wɪð ðɪs ˈtɑpɪk ɪz ˌɪnˈkrɛdəbli ˈvæljəbəl/

segments.text: That's absolutely right.
segments.ipa: /ðæts ˌæbsəˈlutli raɪt/

segments.text: Thinking about technology, um, it goes far beyond just the latest apps or gadgets you carry around.
segments.ipa: /ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ʌm ɪt ɡoʊz fɑr bɪˈɑnd dʒʌst ðə ˈleɪtəst æps ɔr ˈɡædʒəts ju ˈkæri ərˈaʊnd/

segments.text: It's this pervasive, really powerful force that has propelled human development forward.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ðɪs pərˈveɪsɪv ˈrɪli ˈpaʊərfəl fɔrs ðæt hæz prəˈpɛld ˈhjumən dɪˈvɛləpmənt ˈfɔrwərd/

segments.text: Sometimes in obvious ways, sometimes more subtly.
segments.ipa: /səmˈtaɪmz ɪn ˈɑbviəs weɪz səmˈtaɪmz mɔr ˈsʌtəli/

segments.text: and navigating the complexities of today's world, maybe even anticipating what's coming tomorrow.
segments.ipa: /ənd ˈnævəˌɡeɪtɪŋ ðə kəmˈplɛksɪtiz ʌv təˈdeɪz wɝld ˈmeɪbi ˈivɪn ænˈtɪsəˌpeɪtɪŋ wʌts ˈkʌmɪŋ təˈmɑˌroʊ/

segments.text: It really requires a solid grasp of this subject, understanding its roots, its reach,
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈrɪli riˈkwaɪərz ə ˈsɑləd ɡræsp ʌv ðɪs səbˈdʒɛkt ˌʌndərˈstændɪŋ ɪts ruts ɪts ritʃ/

segments.text: and uh the big questions it raises.
segments.ipa: /ənd ʌ ðə bɪɡ ˈkwɛstʃənz ɪt ˈreɪzəz/

segments.text: And that's exactly what we're setting out to do in this deep dive.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðæts ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt wir ˈsɛtɪŋ aʊt tu du ɪn ðɪs dip daɪv/

segments.text: We're going to explore this crucial area by unpacking the material we have, sort of pulling out the key insights.
segments.ipa: /wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ɪkˈsplɔr ðɪs ˈkruʃəl ˈɛriə baɪ ənˈpækɪŋ ðə məˈtɪriəl wi hæv sɔrt ʌv ˈpʊlɪŋ aʊt ðə ki ˈɪnˌsaɪts/

segments.text: We'll look at the journey technology has taken, its, you know, profound effects on society and the economy,
segments.ipa: /wil lʊk æt ðə ˈdʒɝni tɛkˈnɑlədʒi hæz ˈteɪkən ɪts ju noʊ proʊˈfaʊnd ɪˈfɛkts ɑn səˈsaɪəti ənd ðə ɪˈkɑnəmi/

segments.text: and maybe where innovation might be heading.
segments.ipa: /ənd ˈmeɪbi wɛr ˌɪnəˈveɪʃən maɪt bi ˈhɛdɪŋ/

segments.text: So, where do we even begin this exploration?
segments.ipa: /soʊ wɛr du wi ˈivɪn bɪˈɡɪn ðɪs ˌɛksplərˈeɪʃən/

segments.text: Let's maybe start right at the beginning.
segments.ipa: /lɛts ˈmeɪbi stɑrt raɪt æt ðə bɪˈɡɪnɪŋ/

segments.text: Tracing technologies path through time.
segments.ipa: /ˈtreɪsɪŋ tɛkˈnɑlədʒiz pæθ θru taɪm/

segments.text: Sounds like a good play, huh?
segments.ipa: /saʊndz laɪk ə ɡʊd pleɪ hʌ/

segments.text: The story of human technology is, well, it's as old as humanity itself.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈstɔri ʌv ˈhjumən tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ɪz wɛl ɪts æz oʊld æz hjuˈmænɪti ˌɪtˈsɛlf/

segments.text: Really, our material shows us that the earliest uh truly significant steps happened way back in prehistoric and ancient times.
segments.ipa: /ˈrɪli ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl ʃoʊz ʌs ðæt ðə ˈɝliəst ʌ ˈtruli səɡˈnɪfɪkənt stɛps ˈhæpənd weɪ bæk ɪn ˌprihɪˈstɔrɪk ənd ˈeɪntʃənt taɪmz/

segments.text: When you think about those foundational innovations, what often comes to mind are things like um rudimentary stone tools.
segments.ipa: /wɛn ju θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ðoʊz faʊnˈdeɪʃənəl ˌɪnəˈveɪʃənz wʌt ˈɔfən kʌmz tu maɪnd ɑr θɪŋz laɪk ʌm ˌrudəˈmɛntəri stoʊn tulz/

segments.text: And these weren't just rough objects.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðiz ˈwɝənt dʒʌst rʌf ˈɑbdʒɛkts/

segments.text: You know, the development of techniques to nap stone, to make sharp edges or points,
segments.ipa: /ju noʊ ðə dɪˈvɛləpmənt ʌv tɛkˈniks tu næp stoʊn tu meɪk ʃɑrp ˈɛdʒəz ɔr pɔɪnts/

segments.text: that was revolutionary.
segments.ipa: /ðæt wɑz ˌrɛvəˈluʃəˌnɛri/

segments.text: It allowed early humans to process food much more effectively, create other tools, and frankly gave them a significant survival advantage.
segments.ipa: /ɪt əˈlaʊd ˈɝli ˈhjumənz tu ˈprɑˌsɛs fud mʌtʃ mɔr ɪˈfɛktɪvli kriˈeɪt ˈʌðər tulz ənd ˈfræŋkli ɡeɪv ðɛm ə səɡˈnɪfɪkənt sərˈvaɪvəl ædˈvæntɪdʒ/

segments.text: I can imagine that shifted everything.
segments.ipa: /aɪ kæn ˌɪˈmædʒən ðæt ˈʃɪftɪd ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ/

segments.text: Hunting, gathering, even just basic defense must have changed completely.
segments.ipa: /ˈhʌntɪŋ ˈɡæðərɪŋ ˈivɪn dʒʌst ˈbeɪsɪk dɪˈfɛns mʌst hæv tʃeɪndʒd kəmˈplitli/

segments.text: What came next?
segments.ipa: /wʌt keɪm nɛkst/

segments.text: Well, the controlled use of fire was another monumental leap forward.
segments.ipa: /wɛl ðə kənˈtroʊld jus ʌv ˈfaɪər wɑz əˈnʌðər ˌmɑnjəˈmɛntəl lip ˈfɔrwərd/

segments.text: Our material describes it as uh transformative.
segments.ipa: /ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl dɪˈskraɪbz ɪt æz ʌ ˌtrænsˈfɔrmɑˌtɪv/

segments.text: It provided warmth, protection from predators, which obviously expanded where humans could actually live.
segments.ipa: /ɪt prəˈvaɪdɪd wɔrmθ prəˈtɛkʃən frʌm ˈprɛdətərz wɪtʃ ˈɑbviəsli ɪkˈspændəd wɛr ˈhjumənz kʊd ˈækˌtʃuəli laɪv/

segments.text: But maybe even more critically, it allowed for cooking.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ˈmeɪbi ˈivɪn mɔr ˈkrɪtɪkəli ɪt əˈlaʊd fɔr ˈkʊkɪŋ/

segments.text: And cooking made food safer, easier to digest.
segments.ipa: /ənd ˈkʊkɪŋ meɪd fud ˈseɪfər ˈiziər tu daɪˈdʒɛst/

segments.text: That potentially had huge impacts on human evolution itself.
segments.ipa: /ðæt pəˈtɛnʃəli hæd hjudʒ ˌɪmˈpækts ɑn ˈhjumən ˌɛvəˈluʃən ˌɪtˈsɛlf/

segments.text: Fire became central to early communities, didn't it?
segments.ipa: /ˈfaɪər bɪˈkeɪm ˈsɛntrəl tu ˈɝli kəmˈjunətiz ˈdɪdənt ɪt/

segments.text: A gathering point for social interaction and shared resources.
segments.ipa: /ə ˈɡæðərɪŋ pɔɪnt fɔr ˈsoʊʃəl ˌɪntərˈækʃən ənd ʃɛrd ˈrisɔrsɪz/

segments.text: And then there's something we still use every single day, though, in uh vastly more complex forms now. The wheel. The wheel. Yes.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðɛn ðɛrz ˈsʌmθɪŋ wi stɪl jus ˈɛvəri ˈsɪŋɡəl deɪ ðoʊ ɪn ʌ ˈvæstli mɔr ˈkɑmplɛks fɔrmz naʊ ðə wil ðə wil jɛs/

segments.text: It seems incredibly simple to us now, but its invention was frankly a stroke of genius back then.
segments.ipa: /ɪt simz ˌɪnˈkrɛdəbli ˈsɪmpəl tu ʌs naʊ bʌt ɪts ˌɪnˈvɛnʃən wɑz ˈfræŋkli ə stroʊk ʌv ˈdʒinjəs bæk ðɛn/

segments.text: Our material really emphasizes its vital role far beyond just moving things around.
segments.ipa: /ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl ˈrɪli ˈɛmfəˌsaɪzəz ɪts ˈvaɪtəl roʊl fɑr bɪˈɑnd dʒʌst ˈmuvɪŋ θɪŋz ərˈaʊnd/

segments.text: Transportation is obvious, but it was crucial for early agriculture, too. How so?
segments.ipa: /ˌtrænspərˈteɪʃən ɪz ˈɑbviəs bʌt ɪt wɑz ˈkruʃəl fɔr ˈɝli ˈæɡrɪˌkʌltʃər tu haʊ soʊ/

segments.text: Think about irrigation systems, maybe simple machines for grinding grain, things like that.
segments.ipa: /θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ˌɪrəˈɡeɪʃən ˈsɪstəmz ˈmeɪbi ˈsɪmpəl məˈʃinz fɔr ˈɡraɪndɪŋ ɡreɪn θɪŋz laɪk ðæt/

segments.text: And perhaps most significantly, it was a catalyst for trade and commerce.
segments.ipa: /ənd pərˈhæps moʊst sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli ɪt wɑz ə ˈkætələst fɔr treɪd ənd ˈkɑmərs/

segments.text: I mean, just imagine trying to move goods, any significant amount of goods over distance without wheeled carts.
segments.ipa: /aɪ min dʒʌst ˌɪˈmædʒən ˈtraɪɪŋ tu muv ɡʊdz ˈɛni səɡˈnɪfɪkənt əˈmaʊnt ʌv ɡʊdz ˈoʊvər ˈdɪstəns wɪˈθaʊt wild kɑrts/

segments.text: It's almost impossible to picture. Right.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ˈɔlˌmoʊst ˌɪmˈpɑsəbəl tu ˈpɪktʃər raɪt/

segments.text: It would have been incredibly slow and difficult. Exactly.
segments.ipa: /ɪt wʊd hæv bɪn ˌɪnˈkrɛdəbli sloʊ ənd ˈdɪfəkəlt ɪɡˈzæktli/

segments.text: The material highlights how the wheel directly facilitated early economic activity by making transport far far more efficient.
segments.ipa: /ðə məˈtɪriəl ˈhaɪˌlaɪts haʊ ðə wil dərˈɛktli fəˈsɪləˌteɪtɪd ˈɝli ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk ækˈtɪvəti baɪ ˈmeɪkɪŋ trænˈspɔrt fɑr fɑr mɔr ɪˈfɪʃənt/

segments.text: These were, you know, using the language here, fundamental almost rudimentary innovations.
segments.ipa: /ðiz wɝ ju noʊ ˈjuzɪŋ ðə ˈlæŋɡwədʒ hir ˌfʌndəˈmɛntəl ˈɔlˌmoʊst ˌrudəˈmɛntəri ˌɪnəˈveɪʃənz/

segments.text: But they were incredibly powerful technological catalysts.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ðeɪ wɝ ˌɪnˈkrɛdəbli ˈpaʊərfəl ˌtɛknəˈlɑdʒɪkəl ˈkætələsts/

segments.text: They really set the stage for significant societal advancement.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ ˈrɪli sɛt ðə steɪdʒ fɔr səɡˈnɪfɪkənt səˈsaɪɪtəl ədˈvænsmənt/

segments.text: It just proves that even the most basic seeming inventions can profoundly shape civilizations.
segments.ipa: /ɪt dʒʌst pruvz ðæt ˈivɪn ðə moʊst ˈbeɪsɪk ˈsimɪŋ ˌɪnˈvɛnʃənz kæn proʊˈfaʊndli ʃeɪp ˌsɪvəlɪˈzeɪʃənz/

segments.text: It is fascinating, isn't it, to think how those tools which seem so basic to us were once the absolute cutting edge and completely reshaped life.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ɪz ˈfæsəˌneɪtɪŋ ˈɪzənt ɪt tu θɪŋk haʊ ðoʊz tulz wɪtʃ sim soʊ ˈbeɪsɪk tu ʌs wɝ wʌns ðə ˈæbsəˌlut ˈkʌtɪŋ ɛdʒ ənd kəmˈplitli riˈʃeɪpt laɪf/

segments.text: Okay, let's fast forward quite a bit then.
segments.ipa: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ lɛts fæst ˈfɔrwərd kwaɪt ə bɪt ðɛn/

segments.text: What happened when we got to the industrial revolution?
segments.ipa: /wʌt ˈhæpənd wɛn wi ɡɑt tu ðə ˌɪnˈdʌstriəl ˌrɛvəˈluʃən/

segments.text: This feels like a much more uh rapid disruptive period.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs filz laɪk ə mʌtʃ mɔr ʌ ˈræpəd dɪsˈrʌptɪv ˈpɪriəd/

segments.text: It absolutely was.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˌæbsəˈlutli wɑz/

segments.text: That period roughly spanning from say 1760 to 1840 is indeed characterized as an industrial upheaval.
segments.ipa: /ðæt ˈpɪriəd ˈrʌfli ˈspænɪŋ frʌm seɪ tu ɪz ˌɪnˈdid ˈkɛrəktərˌaɪzd æz æn ˌɪnˈdʌstriəl əpˈhivəl/

segments.text: It wasn't just a step forward.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈwɑzənt dʒʌst ə stɛp ˈfɔrwərd/

segments.text: It was a complete paradigm shift in how things were made, in daily life, everything.
segments.ipa: /ɪt wɑz ə kəmˈplit ˈpɛrəˌdaɪm ʃɪft ɪn haʊ θɪŋz wɝ meɪd ɪn ˈdeɪli laɪf ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ/

segments.text: Our material points to key technologies like the steam engine that mechanized power generation,
segments.ipa: /ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl pɔɪnts tu ki tɛkˈnɑlədʒiz laɪk ðə stim ˈɛndʒən ðæt ˈmɛkəˌnaɪzd ˈpaʊər ˌdʒɛnərˈeɪʃən/

segments.text: freeing manufacturing from needing to be right next to a river, for instance, right?
segments.ipa: /ˈfriɪŋ ˌmænjəˈfæktʃərɪŋ frʌm ˈnidɪŋ tu bi raɪt nɛkst tu ə ˈrɪvər fɔr ˈɪnstəns raɪt/

segments.text: Power anywhere pretty much.
segments.ipa: /ˈpaʊər ˈɛniˌwɛr ˈprɪti mʌtʃ/

segments.text: Then you had mechanized textile production machines like the power loom that dramatically increased the speed and scale at which fabrics could be made.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn ju hæd ˈmɛkəˌnaɪzd ˈtɛkˌstaɪl prəˈdʌkʃən məˈʃinz laɪk ðə ˈpaʊər lum ðæt drəˈmætɪkli ˌɪnˈkrist ðə spid ənd skeɪl æt wɪtʃ ˈfæbrɪks kʊd bi meɪd/

segments.text: It created entirely new factory systems, huge factories. Right. Exactly.
segments.ipa: /ɪt kriˈeɪtəd ɪnˈtaɪərli nu ˈfæktəri ˈsɪstəmz hjudʒ ˈfæktəriz raɪt ɪɡˈzæktli/

segments.text: And alongside that, the development of railways powered by those same steam engines that just shrank distances and integrated markets in ways that were completely unprecedented.
segments.ipa: /ənd əˈlɔŋˈsaɪd ðæt ðə dɪˈvɛləpmənt ʌv ˈreɪlˌweɪz ˈpaʊərd baɪ ðoʊz seɪm stim ˈɛndʒənz ðæt dʒʌst ʃræŋk ˈdɪstənsəz ənd ˈɪntəˌɡreɪtəd ˈmɑrkəts ɪn weɪz ðæt wɝ kəmˈplitli ənˈprɛsɪˌdɛntɪd/

segments.text: And the impact wasn't just technological, was it?
segments.ipa: /ənd ðə ˌɪmˈpækt ˈwɑzənt dʒʌst ˌtɛknəˈlɑdʒɪkəl wɑz ɪt/

segments.text: It sounds like it completely reshaped societies as well. Oh, absolutely.
segments.ipa: /ɪt saʊndz laɪk ɪt kəmˈplitli riˈʃeɪpt səˈsaɪətiz æz wɛl oʊ ˌæbsəˈlutli/

segments.text: Our material describes how these technologies fueled rapid urbanization.
segments.ipa: /ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl dɪˈskraɪbz haʊ ðiz tɛkˈnɑlədʒiz ˈfjuəld ˈræpəd ˌɝbənəˈzeɪʃən/

segments.text: People moved in huge numbers from rural areas to these new factory towns looking for work.
segments.ipa: /ˈpipəl muvd ɪn hjudʒ ˈnʌmbərz frʌm ˈrʊrəl ˈɛriəz tu ðiz nu ˈfæktəri taʊnz ˈlʊkɪŋ fɔr wɝk/

segments.text: It drove significant economic growth, no doubt created new industries, new wealth.
segments.ipa: /ɪt droʊv səɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk ɡroʊθ noʊ daʊt kriˈeɪtəd nu ˈɪndəstriz nu wɛlθ/

segments.text: However, and this is crucial, the material is very careful to highlight the significant negative consequences that came with it.
segments.ipa: /ˌhaʊˈɛvər ənd ðɪs ɪz ˈkruʃəl ðə məˈtɪriəl ɪz ˈvɛri ˈkɛrfəl tu ˈhaɪˌlaɪt ðə səɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˈnɛɡətɪv ˈkɑnsəˌkwɛnsəz ðæt keɪm wɪð ɪt/

segments.text: Likewise, it points to widespread labor exploitation, often brutal working conditions, incredibly long hours,

segments.text: It's incredible how those early theoretical questions have led to technologies we interact with,

segments.text: However, the material immediately raises significant concerns.
segments.ipa: /ˌhaʊˈɛvər ðə məˈtɪriəl ˌɪˈmiˌdiətli ˈreɪzəz səɡˈnɪfɪkənt kənˈsɝnz/

segments.text: It highlights the potential for widespread technological unemployment.

segments.ipa: /ðɪs kæn lɛd tu ˈrɪli ənˈfɛr ˈaʊtˌkʌmz ɪn ˈkruʃəl ˈɛriəz laɪk ˈhaɪrɪŋ dɪˈsɪʒənz loʊn ˌæpləˈkeɪʃənz/

segments.text: about ethics, and maybe even the very nature of intelligence itself.
segments.ipa: /əˈbaʊt ˈɛθɪks ənd ˈmeɪbi ˈivɪn ðə ˈvɛri ˈneɪtʃər ʌv ˌɪnˈtɛlədʒəns ˌɪtˈsɛlf/

segments.text: That seems like a core debate for our time.

segments.text: It absolutely is.

segments.text: and seriously considering the potential socioeconomic implications like technological unemployment. It's complex.

segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈrɪli hæz lɛft æn ˌɪnˈdɛlɪbəl ˈfʊtˌprɪnt ˈɛvriˌwɛr/

segments.ipa: /haʊ hæz tɛkˈnɑlədʒi tʃeɪndʒd ðə ˌfʌndəˈmɛntəl weɪ wi lɝn ənd titʃ/

segments.text: available to anyone.
segments.ipa: /əˈveɪləbəl tu ˈɛniˌwʌn/

segments.text: And alongside that, there's the increasing prevalence of virtual classrooms, online learning tools, collaborative software,
segments.ipa: /ənd əˈlɔŋˈsaɪd ðæt ðɛrz ðə ˌɪnˈkrisɪŋ ˈprɛvələns ʌv ˈvɝtʃuəl ˈklæsˌrumz ˈɔnˌlaɪn ˈlɝnɪŋ tulz kəˈlæbərˌeɪtɪv ˈsɔfˌtwɛr/

segments.text: making learning more flexible.
segments.ipa: /ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˈlɝnɪŋ mɔr ˈflɛksəbəl/

segments.text: or people who simply can't attend traditional institutions because of work or family commitments.
segments.ipa: /ɔr ˈpipəl hu ˈsɪmpli kænt əˈtɛnd trəˈdɪʃənəl ˌɪnstɪˈtuʃənz bɪˈkɔz ʌv wɝk ɔr ˈfæməli kəˈmɪtmənts/

segments.ipa: /ðæt saʊndz laɪk ə hjudʒ stɛp təˈwɔrdz dɪˈmɑkrəˌtaɪzɪŋ ˌɛdʒəˈkeɪʃən ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˈnɑlədʒ əˈveɪləbəl mɔr ˈwaɪdli/

segments.text: But you mentioned accessibility.

segments.ipa: /ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl ɪz kwaɪt ˈkɛrfəl tu ˌɪˈmiˌdiətli ˌɪntrəˈdus ðə ˈkrɪtɪkəl ˈtʃæləndʒ ðə ˈdɪdʒətəl dɪˈvaɪd/

segments.ipa: /ðɪs ɪz əˈnʌðər ˈsɛktər ɪkˈspɪriənsɪŋ ˈtruli ˌrɛvəˈluʃəˌnɛri ˈtʃeɪndʒəz ˈdrɪvən baɪ tɛkˈnɑlədʒi/

segments.ipa: /ðə sɝdʒ ɪn ðə jus ʌv ˈtɛli ˈmɛdəsən ˈdʊrɪŋ ðæt ˈkraɪsəs/

segments.text: Platforms like Teddoc saw massive increases in usage really demonstrated technologies vital role in a crisis situation.
segments.ipa: /ˈplætˌfɔrmz laɪk Teddoc sɔ ˈmæsɪv ɪnˈkrisəz ɪn ˈjusədʒ ˈrɪli ˈdɛmənˌstreɪtɪd tɛkˈnɑlədʒiz ˈvaɪtəl roʊl ɪn ə ˈkraɪsəs ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən/

segments.text: It makes perfect sense, doesn't it?
segments.ipa: /ɪt meɪks pərˈfɛkt sɛns ˈdʌzənt ɪt/

segments.text: Tele medicine became a critical tool for providing safe medical consultations without the risk of spreading the virus.
segments.ipa: /ˈtɛli ˈmɛdəsən bɪˈkeɪm ə ˈkrɪtɪkəl tul fɔr prəˈvaɪdɪŋ seɪf ˈmɛdəkəl ˌkɑnsəlˈteɪʃənz wɪˈθaʊt ðə rɪsk ʌv ˈsprɛdɪŋ ðə ˈvaɪrəs/

segments.text: That was essential for protecting both patients and healthcare workers, especially early on, and it must have helped alleviate some of the immense pressure on hospitals and clinics
segments.ipa: /ðæt wɑz ɛˈsɛnʃəl fɔr prəˈtɛktɪŋ boʊθ ˈpeɪʃənts ənd ˈhɛlθˌkɛr ˈwɝkərz əˈspɛʃli ˈɝli ɑn ənd ɪt mʌst hæv hɛlpt əˈliviˌeɪt sʌm ʌv ðə ˌɪˈmɛns ˈprɛʃər ɑn ˈhɑˌspɪtəlz ənd ˈklɪnɪks/

segments.text: when they were overwhelmed. Precisely.
segments.ipa: /wɛn ðeɪ wɝ ˌoʊvərˈwɛlmd prɪˈsaɪsli/

segments.text: These technologies clearly improve healthcare accessibility, particularly for people in rural or remote areas or maybe those with mobility issues who find it hard to travel.
segments.ipa: /ðiz tɛkˈnɑlədʒiz ˈklɪrli ˌɪmˈpruv ˈhɛlθˌkɛr ˌæksɛsəˈbɪlɪti ˌpɑrˈtɪkjələrli fɔr ˈpipəl ɪn ˈrʊrəl ɔr rɪˈmoʊt ˈɛriəz ɔr ˈmeɪbi ðoʊz wɪð moʊˈbɪləti ˈɪʃuz hu faɪnd ɪt hɑrd tu ˈtrævəl/

segments.text: They also hold enormous potential for enhancing the quality of care through more personalized monitoring from wearables,
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ hoʊld ɪˈnɔrməs pəˈtɛnʃəl fɔr ɛnˈhænsɪŋ ðə ˈkwɑləti ʌv kɛr θru mɔr ˈpɝsənəˌlaɪzd ˈmɑnətərɪŋ frʌm wearables/

segments.text: maybe faster AI assisted diagnostics.
segments.ipa: /ˈmeɪbi ˈfæstər aɪ əˈsɪstɪd ˌdaɪəɡˈnɑstɪks/

segments.text: This often contributes to what's called precision medicine, tailoring treatments more effectively.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ˈɔfən kənˈtrɪbjuts tu wʌts kɔld priˈsɪʒən ˈmɛdəsən ˈteɪlərɪŋ ˈtritmənts mɔr ɪˈfɛktɪvli/

segments.text: Just think for a moment about your own interactions with the health care system recently.
segments.ipa: /dʒʌst θɪŋk fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt əˈbaʊt jɔr oʊn ˌɪntərˈækʃənz wɪð ðə hɛlθ kɛr ˈsɪstəm ˈrisəntli/

segments.text: Have you or perhaps someone you know used tele medicine?
segments.ipa: /hæv ju ɔr pərˈhæps ˈsʌmˌwʌn ju noʊ juzd ˈtɛli ˈmɛdəsən/

segments.text: Do you wear a fitness tracker?
segments.ipa: /du ju wɛr ə ˈfɪtnəs ˈtrækər/

segments.text: These are direct examples of this teaalth revolution in action.
segments.ipa: /ðiz ɑr dərˈɛkt ɪɡˈzæmpəlz ʌv ðɪs teaalth ˌrɛvəˈluʃən ɪn ˈækʃən/

segments.text: Now, let's turn to something that, well, touches almost everyone's life daily. Social media.
segments.ipa: /naʊ lɛts tɝn tu ˈsʌmθɪŋ ðæt wɛl ˈtʌtʃəz ˈɔlˌmoʊst ˈɛvriˌwʌnz laɪf ˈdeɪli ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmidiə/

segments.text: The material acknowledges its undeniable power for global connection and information sharing.
segments.ipa: /ðə məˈtɪriəl ækˈnɑlɪdʒɪz ɪts ˌʌndɪˈnaɪəbəl ˈpaʊər fɔr ˈɡloʊbəl kəˈnɛkʃən ənd ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən ˈʃɛrɪŋ/

segments.text: It uses platforms like X, formerly Twitter, as an example of how people can communicate and share ideas across the world almost instantly.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈjusəz ˈplætˌfɔrmz laɪk ɛks ˈfɔrmərli ˈtwɪtər æz æn ɪɡˈzæmpəl ʌv haʊ ˈpipəl kæn kəmˈjunəˌkeɪt ənd ʃɛr aɪˈdiəz əˈkrɔs ðə wɝld ˈɔlˌmoʊst ˈɪnstəntli/

segments.text: And that ability to connect across borders, across cultures, is powerful.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðæt əˈbɪləˌti tu kəˈnɛkt əˈkrɔs ˈbɔrdərz əˈkrɔs ˈkʌltʃərz ɪz ˈpaʊərfəl/

segments.text: No doubt about it.
segments.ipa: /noʊ daʊt əˈbaʊt ɪt/

segments.text: However, our material is equally firm, perhaps even more so, in highlighting the significant negative consequences associated with social media,
segments.ipa: /ˌhaʊˈɛvər ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl ɪz ˈikwəli fɝm pərˈhæps ˈivɪn mɔr soʊ ɪn ˈhaɪˌlaɪtɪŋ ðə səɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˈnɛɡətɪv ˈkɑnsəˌkwɛnsəz əˈsoʊsiˌeɪtɪd wɪð ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmidiə/

segments.text: such as well, it points to its documented contribution to mental health issues, particularly among younger people,
segments.ipa: /sʌtʃ æz wɛl ɪt pɔɪnts tu ɪts ˈdɑkjəˌmɛntəd ˌkɑntrəbˈjuʃən tu ˈmɛntəl hɛlθ ˈɪʃuz ˌpɑrˈtɪkjələrli əˈmʌŋ ˈjʌŋɡər ˈpipəl/

segments.text: citing things like increased feelings of inadequacy, anxiety, depression, often linked to constant social comparison and the pressure to present a perfect image online.
segments.ipa: /ˈsaɪtɪŋ θɪŋz laɪk ˌɪnˈkrist ˈfilɪŋz ʌv ˌɪˈnædɪkwəsi æŋˈzaɪəti dɪˈprɛʃən ˈɔfən lɪŋkt tu ˈkɑnstənt ˈsoʊʃəl kəmˈpɛrəsən ənd ðə ˈprɛʃər tu ˈprɛzənt ə pərˈfɛkt ˈɪmədʒ ˈɔnˌlaɪn/

segments.text: The curated life effect. Exactly.
segments.ipa: /ðə kjʊˈreɪtɪd laɪf ɪˈfɛkt ɪɡˈzæktli/

segments.text: It also emphasizes social media's role in the rapid and widespread dissemination of misinformation and disinformation.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈɔlsoʊ ˈɛmfəˌsaɪzəz ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmidiəz roʊl ɪn ðə ˈræpəd ənd ˈwaɪdˈsprɛd dɪˌsɛməˈneɪʃən ʌv ˌmɪsɪnfərˈmeɪʃən ənd dɪˌzɪnfərˈmeɪʃən/

segments.text: It's become incredibly challenging for individuals to discern what's true from what's false online.
segments.ipa: /ɪts bɪˈkʌm ˌɪnˈkrɛdəbli ˈtʃæləndʒɪŋ fɔr ˌɪndəˈvɪdʒəwəlz tu dɪˈsɝn wʌts tru frʌm wʌts fɔls ˈɔnˌlaɪn/

segments.text: And finally, it notes that these platforms can contribute to increased societal polarization by creating filter bubbles or echo chambers where individuals are primarily exposed only to viewpoints
segments.ipa: /ənd ˈfaɪnəli ɪt noʊts ðæt ðiz ˈplætˌfɔrmz kæn kənˈtrɪbjut tu ˌɪnˈkrist səˈsaɪɪtəl ˌpoʊlərəˈzeɪʃən baɪ kriˈeɪtɪŋ ˈfɪltər ˈbʌbəlz ɔr ˈɛkoʊ ˈtʃeɪmbərz wɛr ˌɪndəˈvɪdʒəwəlz ɑr praɪˈmɛrəli ɪkˈspoʊzd ˈoʊnli tu ˈvjuˌpɔɪnts/

segments.text: that reinforce their own beliefs, limiting exposure to different perspectives. Yes.
segments.ipa: /ðæt ˌriɪnˈfɔrs ðɛr oʊn bɪˈlifs ˈlɪmətɪŋ ɪkˈspoʊʒər tu ˈdɪfərənt pərˈspɛktɪvz jɛs/

segments.text: which can foster division and what the material calls social fragmentation that resonates very strongly.
segments.ipa: /wɪtʃ kæn ˈfɑstər dɪˈvɪʒən ənd wʌt ðə məˈtɪriəl kɔlz ˈsoʊʃəl ˌfræɡmənˈteɪʃən ðæt ˈrɛzəˌneɪts ˈvɛri ˈstrɔŋli/

segments.text: I think most of us probably have a complicated relationship with social media.
segments.ipa: /aɪ θɪŋk moʊst ʌv ʌs ˈprɑbəˌbli hæv ə ˈkɑmpləˌkeɪtəd riˈleɪʃənˌʃɪp wɪð ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmidiə/

segments.text: We experience the benefits of connection, staying in touch, finding communities, but also feel the downsides like information overload or seeing angry divisive content.
segments.ipa: /wi ɪkˈspɪriəns ðə ˈbɛnəfɪts ʌv kəˈnɛkʃən ˈsteɪɪŋ ɪn tʌtʃ ˈfaɪndɪŋ kəmˈjunətiz bʌt ˈɔlsoʊ fil ðə ˈdaʊnˌsaɪdz laɪk ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən ˈoʊvərˌloʊd ɔr ˈsiɪŋ ˈæŋɡri dɪˈvaɪsɪv ˈkɑntɛnt/

segments.text: The material even touches on the idea of a digital detox as a sort of conscious response to feeling overwhelmed by it all. It does.
segments.ipa: /ðə məˈtɪriəl ˈivɪn ˈtʌtʃəz ɑn ðə aɪˈdiə ʌv ə ˈdɪdʒətəl ˈdiˌtɑks æz ə sɔrt ʌv ˈkɑnʃəs rɪˈspɑns tu ˈfilɪŋ ˌoʊvərˈwɛlmd baɪ ɪt ɔl ɪt dʌz/

segments.text: And it really prompts a significant question for society, doesn't it?
segments.ipa: /ənd ɪt ˈrɪli prɑmpts ə səɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˈkwɛstʃən fɔr səˈsaɪəti ˈdʌzənt ɪt/

segments.text: Ultimately, does this technology enhance our social connections, bring us closer together despite distance,
segments.ipa: /ˈʌltəmətli dʌz ðɪs tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ɛnˈhæns ˈaʊər ˈsoʊʃəl kəˈnɛkʃənz brɪŋ ʌs ˈkloʊsər təˈɡɛðər dɪˈspaɪt ˈdɪstəns/

segments.text: or does it fundamentally weaken our relationships by promoting more superficial interactions and contributing to societal divisions?
segments.ipa: /ɔr dʌz ɪt ˌfʌndəˈmɛntəli ˈwikən ˈaʊər riˈleɪʃənˌʃɪps baɪ prəˈmoʊtɪŋ mɔr ˌsupərˈfɪʃəl ˌɪntərˈækʃənz ənd kənˈtrɪbjutɪŋ tu səˈsaɪɪtəl dɪˈvɪʒənz/

segments.text: It's a complex trade-off, and the answer is probably still unfolding.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ə ˈkɑmplɛks ˈtreɪˌdɔf ənd ðə ˈænsər ɪz ˈprɑbəˌbli stɪl ənˈfoʊldɪŋ/

segments.text: Okay, let's look at the economy.
segments.ipa: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ lɛts lʊk æt ðə ɪˈkɑnəmi/

segments.text: Technology is acting as a powerful and often quite disruptive force here.
segments.ipa: /tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ɪz ˈæktɪŋ æz ə ˈpaʊərfəl ənd ˈɔfən kwaɪt dɪsˈrʌptɪv fɔrs hir/

segments.text: Our material details how automation and AI are fundamentally reshaping labor markets.
segments.ipa: /ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl dɪˈteɪlz haʊ ɔtəˈmeɪʃən ənd aɪ ɑr ˌfʌndəˈmɛntəli riˈʃeɪpɪŋ ˈleɪbər ˈmɑrkəts/

segments.text: On the one hand, they are creating entirely new job categories, often requiring advanced technical skills.
segments.ipa: /ɑn ðə wʌn hænd ðeɪ ɑr kriˈeɪtɪŋ ɪnˈtaɪərli nu dʒɑb ˈkætəˌɡɔriz ˈɔfən riˈkwaɪərɪŋ ədˈvænst ˈtɛknɪkəl skɪlz/

segments.text: Think data scientists, AI specialists, cyber security analysts.
segments.ipa: /θɪŋk ˈdeɪtə ˈsaɪəntɪsts aɪ ˈspɛʃələsts ˈsaɪbər sɪkˈjʊrəti ˈænəlɪsts/

segments.text: But on the other hand, they're simultaneously displacing workers in traditional industries.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ɑn ðə ˈʌðər hænd ðɛr ˌsaɪməlˈteɪniəsli dɪˈspleɪsɪŋ ˈwɝkərz ɪn trəˈdɪʃənəl ˈɪndəstriz/

segments.text: We see this clearly in manufacturing and logistics, but increasingly also in some service sectors,
segments.ipa: /wi si ðɪs ˈklɪrli ɪn ˌmænjəˈfæktʃərɪŋ ənd ləˈdʒɪstɪks bʌt ɪnˈkrisɪŋli ˈɔlsoʊ ɪn sʌm ˈsɝvəs ˈsɛktərz/

segments.text: even roles involving routine cognitive tasks.
segments.ipa: /ˈivɪn roʊlz ˌɪnˈvɑlvɪŋ ruˈtin ˈkɑɡnɪtɪv tæsks/

segments.text: And the material points to the rise of the gig economy as a prime illustration of this shift, doesn't it?
segments.ipa: /ənd ðə məˈtɪriəl pɔɪnts tu ðə raɪz ʌv ðə ɡɪɡ ɪˈkɑnəmi æz ə praɪm ˌɪləˈstreɪʃən ʌv ðɪs ʃɪft ˈdʌzənt ɪt/

segments.text: Platforms like Uber or delivery apps.
segments.ipa: /ˈplætˌfɔrmz laɪk ˈjubər ɔr dɪˈlɪvəri æps/

segments.text: These enable flexible work opportunities, allowing people to use technology to find short-term tasks or freelance projects,
segments.ipa: /ðiz ɛˈneɪbəl ˈflɛksəbəl wɝk ˌɑpərˈtunətiz əˈlaʊɪŋ ˈpipəl tu jus tɛkˈnɑlədʒi tu faɪnd ˌʃɔrtˈtɝm tæsks ɔr ˈfriˌlæns ˈprɑdʒɛkts/

segments.text: often bypassing traditional employment structures entirely.
segments.ipa: /ˈɔfən ˈbaɪˌpæsɪŋ trəˈdɪʃənəl ɛmˈplɔɪmənt ˈstrʌktʃərz ɪnˈtaɪərli/

segments.text: That's a very clear example of how technology platforms can create entirely new work structures and business models almost overnight.
segments.ipa: /ðæts ə ˈvɛri klɪr ɪɡˈzæmpəl ʌv haʊ tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ˈplætˌfɔrmz kæn kriˈeɪt ɪnˈtaɪərli nu wɝk ˈstrʌktʃərz ənd ˈbɪznəs ˈmɑdəlz ˈɔlˌmoʊst ˈoʊvərˈnaɪt/

segments.text: Now, the gig economy offers potential benefits, flexibility, lower barriers to entry for some work,
segments.ipa: /naʊ ðə ɡɪɡ ɪˈkɑnəmi ˈɔfərz pəˈtɛnʃəl ˈbɛnəfɪts ˌflɛksəˈbɪləti ˈloʊər ˈbæriərz tu ˈɛntri fɔr sʌm wɝk/

segments.text: but it also raises serious concerns about job security, the lack of traditional employee benefits like health insurance or paid leave,
segments.ipa: /bʌt ɪt ˈɔlsoʊ ˈreɪzəz ˈsɪriəs kənˈsɝnz əˈbaʊt dʒɑb sɪkˈjʊrəti ðə læk ʌv trəˈdɪʃənəl ɛmˈplɔɪi ˈbɛnəfɪts laɪk hɛlθ ˌɪnˈʃʊrəns ɔr peɪd liv/

segments.text: and sometimes wage instability for workers.
segments.ipa: /ənd səmˈtaɪmz weɪdʒ ˌɪnstəˈbɪlɪti fɔr ˈwɝkərz/

segments.text: This is all part of the broader economic disruption driven by technology.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ɪz ɔl pɑrt ʌv ðə ˈbrɔdər ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk dɪsˈrʌpʃən ˈdrɪvən baɪ tɛkˈnɑlədʒi/

segments.text: And it brings back that concern we touched on earlier about technological unemployment where skills mismatch or direct job displacement creates significant challenges for the workforce and society to manage.
segments.ipa: /ənd ɪt brɪŋz bæk ðæt kənˈsɝn wi tʌtʃt ɑn ˈɝliər əˈbaʊt ˌtɛknəˈlɑdʒɪkəl ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt wɛr skɪlz mɪˈsmætʃ ɔr dərˈɛkt dʒɑb dɪˈspleɪsmənt kriˈeɪts səɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˈtʃæləndʒɪz fɔr ðə ˈwɝkˌfɔrs ənd səˈsaɪəti tu ˈmænədʒ/

segments.text: Let's maybe circle back to the tele medicine example again but specifically as a case study focusing on its rapid acceleration during the co9 pandemic because our material
segments.ipa: /lɛts ˈmeɪbi ˈsɝkəl bæk tu ðə ˈtɛli ˈmɛdəsən ɪɡˈzæmpəl əˈɡɛn bʌt spəˈsɪfɪkli æz ə keɪs ˈstʌdi ˈfoʊkəsɪŋ ɑn ɪts ˈræpəd ˌækˌsɛlərˈeɪʃən ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə koʊ pænˈdɛmɪk bɪˈkɔz ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl/

segments.text: gives it quite a bit of prominence.
segments.ipa: /ɡɪvz ɪt kwaɪt ə bɪt ʌv ˈprɑmənəns/

segments.text: As we touched on, platforms like Teldoc saw just massive increases in usage starting in early 2020.
segments.ipa: /æz wi tʌtʃt ɑn ˈplætˌfɔrmz laɪk Teldoc sɔ dʒʌst ˈmæsɪv ɪnˈkrisəz ɪn ˈjusədʒ ˈstɑrtɪŋ ɪn ˈɝli/

segments.text: And that was absolutely vital, wasn't it, for enabling safe health care access during those initial very uncertain phases of the pandemic.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðæt wɑz ˌæbsəˈlutli ˈvaɪtəl ˈwɑzənt ɪt fɔr ɛˈneɪbəlɪŋ seɪf hɛlθ kɛr ˈækˌsɛs ˈdʊrɪŋ ðoʊz ˌɪˈnɪʃəl ˈvɛri ənˈsɝtən ˈfeɪzəz ʌv ðə pænˈdɛmɪk/

segments.text: It reduced the burden on physical healthcare facilities and minimized infection risks for everyone involved. Absolutely.
segments.ipa: /ɪt rəˈdust ðə ˈbɝdən ɑn ˈfɪzɪkəl ˈhɛlθˌkɛr fəˈsɪlətiz ənd ˈmɪnəˌmaɪzd ˌɪnˈfɛkʃən rɪsks fɔr ˈɛvriˌwʌn ˌɪnˈvɑlvd ˌæbsəˈlutli/

segments.text: It was a clear demonstration of technology providing healthcare resilience in a crisis.

segments.text: It acted as a powerful digital intervention during a global emergency.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈæktɪd æz ə ˈpaʊərfəl ˈdɪdʒətəl ˌɪntərˈvɛnʃən ˈdʊrɪŋ ə ˈɡloʊbəl ɪˈmɝdʒənsi/

segments.text: This period while showcasing the clear benefits of tele medicine also starkly exposed and even amplified existing access inequity.

segments.text: meaning meaning that many vulnerable populations, you might think of the elderly, low-income families,
segments.ipa: /ˈminɪŋ ˈminɪŋ ðæt ˈmɛni ˈvʌlnərəbəl ˌpɑpjəˈleɪʃənz ju maɪt θɪŋk ʌv ðə ˈɛldərli ˌloʊˈɪnkəm ˈfæməliz/

segments.text: people in remote rural areas, they often lack the necessary reliable broadband internet access or the right devices or even just the digital literacy needed to actually use
segments.ipa: /ˈpipəl ɪn rɪˈmoʊt ˈrʊrəl ˈɛriəz ðeɪ ˈɔfən læk ðə ˈnɛsəˌsɛri rɪˈlaɪəbəl ˈbrɔdˌbænd ˈɪntərˌnɛt ˈækˌsɛs ɔr ðə raɪt dɪˈvaɪsəz ɔr ˈivɪn dʒʌst ðə ˈdɪdʒətəl ˈlɪtərəsi ˈnidəd tu ˈækˌtʃuəli jus/

segments.text: these tele medicine options effectively.
segments.ipa: /ðiz ˈtɛli ˈmɛdəsən ˈɑpʃənz ɪˈfɛktɪvli/

segments.text: Ah, I see.

segments.text: So, the crisis accelerated the adoption of a potentially beneficial technology.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ðə ˈkraɪsəs ækˈsɛlərˌeɪtɪd ðə əˈdɑpʃən ʌv ə pəˈtɛnʃəli ˌbɛnəˈfɪʃəl tɛkˈnɑlədʒi/

segments.text: But in doing so, it also shown a really harsh light on the digital divide.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ɪn ˈduɪŋ soʊ ɪt ˈɔlsoʊ ʃoʊn ə ˈrɪli hɑrʃ laɪt ɑn ðə ˈdɪdʒətəl dɪˈvaɪd/

segments.text: It showed how unevenly the benefits of technology are actually distributed in society. Precisely.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ʃoʊd haʊ əˈnivənli ðə ˈbɛnəfɪts ʌv tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ɑr ˈækˌtʃuəli dɪˈstrɪbjətəd ɪn səˈsaɪəti prɪˈsaɪsli/

segments.text: It's a powerful illustration of how technologies implementation, especially in critical sectors like healthcare,
segments.ipa: /ɪts ə ˈpaʊərfəl ˌɪləˈstreɪʃən ʌv haʊ tɛkˈnɑlədʒiz ˌɪmpləmɛnˈteɪʃən əˈspɛʃli ɪn ˈkrɪtɪkəl ˈsɛktərz laɪk ˈhɛlθˌkɛr/

segments.text: absolutely must be accompanied by concerted efforts to ensure equitable access.
segments.ipa: /ˌæbsəˈlutli mʌst bi əˈkʌmpənid baɪ kənˈsɝtəd ˈɛfərts tu ɛnˈʃʊr ˈɛkwətəbəl ˈækˌsɛs/

segments.text: Otherwise, you risk worsening the very disparities you might hope technology could help solve. Okay.
segments.ipa: /ˈʌðərˌwaɪz ju rɪsk ˈwɝsənɪŋ ðə ˈvɛri dɪˈspɛrətiz ju maɪt hoʊp tɛkˈnɑlədʒi kʊd hɛlp sɑlv ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: So technology evolving at such a wow breathtaking pace and having such widespread effects across society,
segments.ipa: /soʊ tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ɪˈvɑlvɪŋ æt sʌtʃ ə waʊ ˈbrɛθˌteɪkɪŋ peɪs ənd ˈhævɪŋ sʌtʃ ˈwaɪdˈsprɛd ɪˈfɛkts əˈkrɔs səˈsaɪəti/

segments.text: economy, healthcare, it seems absolutely essential that we spend some time considering the ethical and environmental questions it forces us to confront.
segments.ipa: /ɪˈkɑnəmi ˈhɛlθˌkɛr ɪt simz ˌæbsəˈlutli ɛˈsɛnʃəl ðæt wi spɛnd sʌm taɪm kənˈsɪdərɪŋ ðə ˈɛθɪkəl ənd ɪnˌvaɪrənˈmɛntəl ˈkwɛstʃənz ɪt ˈfɔrsɪz ʌs tu kənˈfrʌnt/

segments.text: It's not just about what technology can do but what it should do, right?
segments.ipa: /ɪts nɑt dʒʌst əˈbaʊt wʌt tɛkˈnɑlədʒi kæn du bʌt wʌt ɪt ʃʊd du raɪt/

segments.text: And what the consequences are.
segments.ipa: /ənd wʌt ðə ˈkɑnsəˌkwɛnsəz ɑr/

segments.text: That's a crucial point. Yes.
segments.ipa: /ðæts ə ˈkruʃəl pɔɪnt jɛs/

segments.text: And one major area of concern highlighted in our material is privacy and data security.
segments.ipa: /ənd wʌn ˈmeɪdʒər ˈɛriə ʌv kənˈsɝn ˈhaɪˌlaɪtɪd ɪn ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl ɪz ˈpraɪvəsi ənd ˈdeɪtə sɪkˈjʊrəti/

segments.text: This comes up again and again.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs kʌmz ʌp əˈɡɛn ənd əˈɡɛn/

segments.text: While technologies like AI powered surveillance systems or facial recognition software can offer potential benefits maybe for public safety,
segments.ipa: /waɪl tɛkˈnɑlədʒiz laɪk aɪ ˈpaʊərd sərˈveɪləns ˈsɪstəmz ɔr ˈfeɪʃəl ˌrɛkəɡˈnɪʃən ˈsɔfˌtwɛr kæn ˈɔfər pəˈtɛnʃəl ˈbɛnəfɪts ˈmeɪbi fɔr ˈpʌblɪk ˈseɪfti/

segments.text: crime prevention, or even just convenience, they also pose significant risks to individual privacy.
segments.ipa: /kraɪm priˈvɛnʃən ɔr ˈivɪn dʒʌst kənˈvinjəns ðeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ poʊz səɡˈnɪfɪkənt rɪsks tu ˌɪndəˈvɪdʒəwəl ˈpraɪvəsi/

segments.text: The sheer ability to collect, analyze, and track vast amounts of personal data creates new vulnerabilities and power imbalances.
segments.ipa: /ðə ʃɪr əˈbɪləˌti tu kəˈlɛkt ˈænəˌlaɪz ənd træk væst əˈmaʊnts ʌv ˈpɝsɪnəl ˈdeɪtə kriˈeɪts nu ˌvʌlnərəˈbɪlɪtiz ənd ˈpaʊər ɪmˈbælənsɪz/

segments.text: And our material provides a very pointed, very well-known example of this vulnerability.
segments.ipa: /ənd ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl prəˈvaɪdz ə ˈvɛri ˈpɔɪntɪd ˈvɛri ˈwɛlˈnoʊn ɪɡˈzæmpəl ʌv ðɪs ˌvʌlnərəˈbɪlɪti/

segments.text: The 2018 Facebook Cambridge Analytica scandal.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈfeɪsˌbʊk ˈkeɪmbrɪdʒ Analytica ˈskændəl/

segments.text: That event really served as a stark global reminder of how personal data collected often implicitly by technology platforms could be harvested and misused without users full understanding
segments.ipa: /ðæt ɪˈvɛnt ˈrɪli sɝvd æz ə stɑrk ˈɡloʊbəl riˈmaɪndər ʌv haʊ ˈpɝsɪnəl ˈdeɪtə kəˈlɛktəd ˈɔfən ˌɪmˈplɪsətli baɪ tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ˈplætˌfɔrmz kʊd bi ˈhɑrvəstɪd ənd mɪsˈjuzd wɪˈθaʊt ˈjuzərz fʊl ˌʌndərˈstændɪŋ/

segments.text: or explicit consent.
segments.ipa: /ɔr ɪkˈsplɪsət kənˈsɛnt/

segments.text: And it impacted everything from political processes to just individual trust in these platforms. Exactly.
segments.ipa: /ənd ɪt ˈɪmˌpæktɪd ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ frʌm pəˈlɪtəkəl ˈprɑsɛsəz tu dʒʌst ˌɪndəˈvɪdʒəwəl trʌst ɪn ðiz ˈplætˌfɔrmz ɪɡˈzæktli/

segments.text: And events like that have fueled widespread calls globally for stronger regulations governing data collection,
segments.ipa: /ənd ɪˈvɛnts laɪk ðæt hæv ˈfjuəld ˈwaɪdˈsprɛd kɔlz ˈɡloʊbəli fɔr ˈstrɔŋər ˌrɛɡjəˈleɪʃənz ˈɡʌvərnɪŋ ˈdeɪtə kəˈlɛkʃən/

segments.text: how data is used, and data security standards.
segments.ipa: /haʊ ˈdeɪtə ɪz juzd ənd ˈdeɪtə sɪkˈjʊrəti ˈstændərdz/

segments.text: The discussion really centers around concepts like data privacy, the inherent risks of algorithmic bias within surveillance technologies leading to unfair targeting of certain groups,
segments.ipa: /ðə dɪˈskʌʃən ˈrɪli ˈsɛntərz ərˈaʊnd ˈkɑnsɛpts laɪk ˈdeɪtə ˈpraɪvəsi ðə ɪnˈhɪrənt rɪsks ʌv ˈælɡərˌɪðəmɪk ˈbaɪəs wɪˈðɪn sərˈveɪləns tɛkˈnɑlədʒiz ˈlidɪŋ tu ənˈfɛr ˈtɑrɡətɪŋ ʌv ˈsɝtən ɡrups/

segments.text: for example, and the challenging ethical balance involved in what's sometimes called ethical surveillance?
segments.ipa: /fɔr ɪɡˈzæmpəl ənd ðə ˈtʃæləndʒɪŋ ˈɛθɪkəl ˈbæləns ˌɪnˈvɑlvd ɪn wʌts səmˈtaɪmz kɔld ˈɛθɪkəl sərˈveɪləns/

segments.text: Where do we draw the line between legitimate security benefits and unacceptable intrusions on personal freedom and privacy?
segments.ipa: /wɛr du wi drɔ ðə laɪn bɪˈtwin ləˈdʒɪtəmət sɪkˈjʊrəti ˈbɛnəfɪts ənd ˌʌnækˈsɛptəbəl ˌɪnˈtruʒənz ɑn ˈpɝsɪnəl ˈfridəm ənd ˈpraɪvəsi/

segments.text: How do we find that balance in an increasingly digitally monitored world?
segments.ipa: /haʊ du wi faɪnd ðæt ˈbæləns ɪn æn ɪnˈkrisɪŋli ˈdɪdʒətəli ˈmɑnətərd wɝld/

segments.text: It's a question societies everywhere are still grappling with.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ə ˈkwɛstʃən səˈsaɪətiz ˈɛvriˌwɛr ɑr stɪl ˈɡræplɪŋ wɪð/

segments.text: Now moving to a completely different but equally complex frontier.
segments.ipa: /naʊ ˈmuvɪŋ tu ə kəmˈplitli ˈdɪfərənt bʌt ˈikwəli ˈkɑmplɛks frənˈtɪr/

segments.text: Genetic engineering and bioeththics.
segments.ipa: /dʒəˈnɛtɪk ˈɛndʒəˈnɪrɪŋ ənd bioeththics/

segments.text: Technologies like crisper gene editing offer astonishing potential.
segments.ipa: /tɛkˈnɑlədʒiz laɪk ˈkrɪspər dʒin ˈɛdətɪŋ ˈɔfər əˈstɑnɪʃɪŋ pəˈtɛnʃəl/

segments.text: The ability to potentially cure inherited diseases at their source by directly modifying DNA. It's revolutionary.
segments.ipa: /ðə əˈbɪləˌti tu pəˈtɛnʃəli kjʊr ˌɪnˈhɛrətɪd dɪˈzizəz æt ðɛr sɔrs baɪ dərˈɛktli ˈmɑdəˌfaɪɪŋ ˈdiˌɛˈneɪ ɪts ˌrɛvəˈluʃəˌnɛri/

segments.text: That sounds incredibly promising from a health perspective. Absolutely.
segments.ipa: /ðæt saʊndz ˌɪnˈkrɛdəbli ˈprɑməsɪŋ frʌm ə hɛlθ pərˈspɛktɪv ˌæbsəˈlutli/

segments.text: Curing genetic diseases would be amazing.
segments.ipa: /ˈkjʊrɪŋ dʒəˈnɛtɪk dɪˈzizəz wʊd bi əˈmeɪzɪŋ/

segments.text: But I know from the material that this area also raises really significant ethical concerns, doesn't it?
segments.ipa: /bʌt aɪ noʊ frʌm ðə məˈtɪriəl ðæt ðɪs ˈɛriə ˈɔlsoʊ ˈreɪzəz ˈrɪli səɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˈɛθɪkəl kənˈsɝnz ˈdʌzənt ɪt/

segments.text: It certainly does.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈsɝtənli dʌz/

segments.text: The material discusses the profound bioethical concerns surrounding the potential for creating so-called designer babies.
segments.ipa: /ðə məˈtɪriəl dɪˈskʌsəz ðə proʊˈfaʊnd bioethical kənˈsɝnz sərˈaʊndɪŋ ðə pəˈtɛnʃəl fɔr kriˈeɪtɪŋ ˈsoʊˈkɔld dɪˈzaɪnər ˈbeɪbiz/

segments.text: Meaning using these technologies not just to cure disease, but perhaps to enhance traits,
segments.ipa: /ˈminɪŋ ˈjuzɪŋ ðiz tɛkˈnɑlədʒiz nɑt dʒʌst tu kjʊr dɪˈziz bʌt pərˈhæps tu ɛnˈhæns treɪts/

segments.text: select for specific characteristics like intelligence or appearance. Precisely.
segments.ipa: /səˈlɛkt fɔr spəˈsɪfɪk ˌkɛrəktərˈɪstɪks laɪk ˌɪnˈtɛlədʒəns ɔr əˈpɪrəns prɪˈsaɪsli/

segments.text: That raises huge questions about equity, human diversity, the potential for unforeseen long-term consequences,
segments.ipa: /ðæt ˈreɪzəz hjudʒ ˈkwɛstʃənz əˈbaʊt ˈɛkwəti ˈhjumən dɪˈvɝsɪti ðə pəˈtɛnʃəl fɔr ˌʌnfɔrˈsin ˈlɔŋˈtɝm ˈkɑnsəˌkwɛnsəz/

segments.text: and what it even means to be human.
segments.ipa: /ənd wʌt ɪt ˈivɪn minz tu bi ˈhjumən/

segments.text: There's also the very real concern about potential inequality and access.
segments.ipa: /ðɛrz ˈɔlsoʊ ðə ˈvɛri ril kənˈsɝn əˈbaʊt pəˈtɛnʃəl ˌɪnɪˈkwɑləti ənd ˈækˌsɛs/

segments.text: If these powerful gene therapies become available, who gets to benefit?
segments.ipa: /ɪf ðiz ˈpaʊərfəl dʒin ˈθɛrəpiz bɪˈkʌm əˈveɪləbəl hu ɡɛts tu ˈbɛnəfɪt/

segments.text: Will they be limited to the wealthy, potentially creating a new biological form of disparity between the enhanced and the unenhanced?
segments.ipa: /wɪl ðeɪ bi ˈlɪmətəd tu ðə ˈwɛlθi pəˈtɛnʃəli kriˈeɪtɪŋ ə nu ˌbaɪəˈlɑdʒɪkəl fɔrm ʌv dɪˈspɛrəti bɪˈtwin ðə ɛnˈhænst ənd ðə unenhanced/

segments.text: So the very ability to edit life itself brings up these deep fundamental questions about the moral implications of well playing with fundamental biological processes and ensuring fairness
segments.ipa: /soʊ ðə ˈvɛri əˈbɪləˌti tu ˈɛdət laɪf ˌɪtˈsɛlf brɪŋz ʌp ðiz dip ˌfʌndəˈmɛntəl ˈkwɛstʃənz əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmɔrəl ˌɪmpləˈkeɪʃənz ʌv wɛl ˈpleɪɪŋ wɪð ˌfʌndəˈmɛntəl ˌbaɪəˈlɑdʒɪkəl ˈprɑsɛsəz ənd ɛnˈʃʊrɪŋ ˈfɛrnəs/

segments.text: and who gets access to these powerful tools. Exactly.
segments.ipa: /ənd hu ɡɛts ˈækˌsɛs tu ðiz ˈpaʊərfəl tulz ɪɡˈzæktli/

segments.text: It forces a really necessary conversation about the need for careful regulation, societal debate,
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈfɔrsɪz ə ˈrɪli ˈnɛsəˌsɛri ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃən əˈbaʊt ðə nid fɔr ˈkɛrfəl ˌrɛɡjəˈleɪʃən səˈsaɪɪtəl dəˈbeɪt/

segments.text: and clear ethical boundaries around genetic manipulation.
segments.ipa: /ənd klɪr ˈɛθɪkəl ˈbaʊndəriz ərˈaʊnd dʒəˈnɛtɪk məˌnɪpjəˈleɪʃən/

segments.text: How do you, the listener, feel about the idea of humans having the power to alter genes in inheritable ways?
segments.ipa: /haʊ du ju ðə ˈlɪsənər fil əˈbaʊt ðə aɪˈdiə ʌv ˈhjumənz ˈhævɪŋ ðə ˈpaʊər tu ˈɔltər dʒinz ɪn ˌɪnˈhɛrətəbəl weɪz/

segments.text: It's a question that challenges deeply held beliefs and values.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ə ˈkwɛstʃən ðæt ˈtʃæləndʒɪz ˈdipli hɛld bɪˈlifs ənd ˈvæljuz/

segments.text: Okay, let's shift gears again and look at technologies relationship with the environment.
segments.ipa: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ lɛts ʃɪft ɡɪrz əˈɡɛn ənd lʊk æt tɛkˈnɑlədʒiz riˈleɪʃənˌʃɪp wɪð ðə ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt/

segments.text: There's a clear duality here as well.
segments.ipa: /ðɛrz ə klɪr duˈæləti hir æz wɛl/

segments.text: On the positive side, technologies like solar panels and wind turbines are absolutely essential sustainable solutions in the fight against climate change.
segments.ipa: /ɑn ðə ˈpɑzətɪv saɪd tɛkˈnɑlədʒiz laɪk ˈsoʊlər ˈpænəlz ənd waɪnd ˈtɝbaɪnz ɑr ˌæbsəˈlutli ɛˈsɛnʃəl səˈsteɪnəbəl səˈluʃənz ɪn ðə faɪt əˈɡɛnst ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ/

segments.text: They offer clean energy alternatives to fossil fuels, which is vital.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ ˈɔfər klin ˈɛnərdʒi ɔlˈtɝnətɪvz tu ˈfɑsəl ˈfjuəlz wɪtʃ ɪz ˈvaɪtəl/

segments.text: That's the hopeful side of the equation.
segments.ipa: /ðæts ðə ˈhoʊpfəl saɪd ʌv ðə ɪˈkweɪʒən/

segments.text: Technology providing tools to potentially heal the planet or at least mitigate damage.
segments.ipa: /tɛkˈnɑlədʒi prəˈvaɪdɪŋ tulz tu pəˈtɛnʃəli hil ðə ˈplænət ɔr at least ˈmɪtəˌɡeɪt ˈdæmədʒ/

segments.text: But our material also highlights a major negative environmental consequence.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl ˈɔlsoʊ ˈhaɪˌlaɪts ə ˈmeɪdʒər ˈnɛɡətɪv ɪnˌvaɪrənˈmɛntəl ˈkɑnsəkwəns/

segments.text: Electronic waste or e-waste.
segments.ipa: /ˌɪˌlɛkˈtrɑnɪk weɪst ɔr e-waste/

segments.text: This is all the discarded electronic equipment, isn't it?
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ɪz ɔl ðə dɪˈskɑrdɪd ˌɪˌlɛkˈtrɑnɪk ɪˈkwɪpmənt ˈɪzənt ɪt/

segments.text: Old phones we upgrade every couple of years.
segments.ipa: /oʊld foʊnz wi əpˈɡreɪd ˈɛvəri ˈkʌpəl ʌv jɪrz/

segments.text: Computers, televisions, printers, even appliances now have electronic components.
segments.ipa: /kəmpˈjutərz ˈtɛləˌvɪʒənz ˈprɪntərz ˈivɪn əˈplaɪənsəz naʊ hæv ˌɪˌlɛkˈtrɑnɪk kəmˈpoʊnənts/

segments.text: And the sheer scale of this problem is staggering.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðə ʃɪr skeɪl ʌv ðɪs ˈprɑbləm ɪz ˈstæɡərˌɪŋ/

segments.text: Our material provides a specific quite alarming statistic.
segments.ipa: /ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl prəˈvaɪdz ə spəˈsɪfɪk kwaɪt əˈlɑrmɪŋ stəˈtɪstɪk/

segments.text: Global e-waste generation reached approximately 59 million tons annually back in 2022.
segments.ipa: /ˈɡloʊbəl e-waste ˌdʒɛnərˈeɪʃən ritʃt əˈprɑksəmətli ˈmɪljən tʌnz ˈænjuəli bæk ɪn/

segments.text: And that number is likely still climbing.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðæt ˈnʌmbər ɪz ˈlaɪkli stɪl ˈklaɪmɪŋ/

segments.text: 59 million tons a year. That's huge. It's enormous.
segments.ipa: /ˈmɪljən tʌnz ə jɪr ðæts hjudʒ ɪts ɪˈnɔrməs/

segments.text: And this waste is often laden with hazardous materials, lead, mercury, cadmium, flame retardants,
segments.ipa: /ənd ðɪs weɪst ɪz ˈɔfən ˈleɪdən wɪð ˈhæzərdəs məˈtɪriəlz lɛd ˈmɝkjəri ˈkædmiəm fleɪm retardants/

segments.text: things that can leech into the soil and groundwater if not disposed of properly.
segments.ipa: /θɪŋz ðæt kæn litʃ ˈɪntu ðə sɔɪl ənd ˈɡraʊnˌdwɑtər ɪf nɑt dɪˈspoʊzd ʌv ˈprɑpərli/

segments.text: This poses serious environmental risks and direct health risks to people living near dumping sites.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ˈpoʊzəz ˈsɪriəs ɪnˌvaɪrənˈmɛntəl rɪsks ənd dərˈɛkt hɛlθ rɪsks tu ˈpipəl ˈlɪvɪŋ nɪr ˈdʌmpɪŋ saɪts/

segments.text: So, the very products of technology, which often aim for efficiency or connectivity, are themselves creating a huge toxic pollution problem at the end of their often short life cycles. Yeah.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ðə ˈvɛri ˈprɑdəkts ʌv tɛkˈnɑlədʒi wɪtʃ ˈɔfən eɪm fɔr ɪˈfɪʃənsi ɔr kənɛkˈtɪvɪti ɑr ðɛmˈsɛlvz kriˈeɪtɪŋ ə hjudʒ ˈtɑksɪk pəˈluʃən ˈprɑbləm æt ðə ɛnd ʌv ðɛr ˈɔfən ʃɔrt laɪf ˈsaɪkəlz jæ/

segments.text: What solutions does the material suggest?
segments.ipa: /wʌt səˈluʃənz dʌz ðə məˈtɪriəl səˈdʒɛst/

segments.text: Well, the material discusses the urgent need for developing more circular economies.
segments.ipa: /wɛl ðə məˈtɪriəl dɪˈskʌsəz ðə ˈɝdʒənt nid fɔr dɪˈvɛləpɪŋ mɔr ˈsɝkjələr ɪˈkɑnəmiz/

segments.text: This means designing products differently from the start, thinking about durability, repairability, reuse, and eventually easier recycling.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs minz dɪˈzaɪnɪŋ ˈprɑdəkts ˈdɪfrəntli frʌm ðə stɑrt ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt dərəˈbɪlɪti repairability riˈjus ənd ɪˈvɛntʃəwəli ˈiziər riˈsaɪkəlɪŋ/

segments.text: It also emphasizes the need to significantly improve e-waste management practices globally, ensuring that valuable materials like gold or copper are recovered safely and that the toxic components
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈɔlsoʊ ˈɛmfəˌsaɪzəz ðə nid tu sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli ˌɪmˈpruv e-waste ˈmænədʒmənt ˈpræktəsəz ˈɡloʊbəli ɛnˈʃʊrɪŋ ðæt ˈvæljəbəl məˈtɪriəlz laɪk ɡoʊld ɔr ˈkɑpər ɑr rəˈkʌvərd ˈseɪfli ənd ðæt ðə ˈtɑksɪk kəmˈpoʊnənts/

segments.text: are handled responsibly, not just dumped.
segments.ipa: /ɑr ˈhændəld rɪˈspɑnsəbli nɑt dʒʌst dʌmpt/

segments.text: The ultimate goal is to drastically reduce technologies overall negative environmental footprint and to really underscore the severity and frankly the global inequality of this e-waste problem.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈʌltəmət ɡoʊl ɪz tu ˈdræstɪkli rəˈdus tɛkˈnɑlədʒiz ˈoʊvərˌɔl ˈnɛɡətɪv ɪnˌvaɪrənˈmɛntəl ˈfʊtˌprɪnt ənd tu ˈrɪli ˌʌndərˈskɔr ðə sɪˈvɛrɪti ənd ˈfræŋkli ðə ˈɡloʊbəl ˌɪnɪˈkwɑləti ʌv ðɪs e-waste ˈprɑbləm/

segments.text: Our material includes a specific case study.
segments.ipa: /ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl ˌɪnˈkludz ə spəˈsɪfɪk keɪs ˈstʌdi/

segments.text: It focuses on how developing nations are often impacted.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈfoʊkəsɪz ɑn haʊ dɪˈvɛləpɪŋ ˈneɪʃənz ɑr ˈɔfən ˈɪmˌpæktɪd/

segments.text: Countries like Ghana, parts of India, Southeast Asia, they disproportionately become destinations for e-waste,
segments.ipa: /ˈkʌntriz laɪk ˈɡænə pɑrts ʌv ˈɪndiə ˌsaʊˈθist ˈeɪʒə ðeɪ ˌdɪsprəˈpɔrʃənətli bɪˈkʌm ˌdɛstəˈneɪʃənz fɔr e-waste/

segments.text: often shipped illegally or under dubious circumstances from developed nations looking to offload the problem cheaply.
segments.ipa: /ˈɔfən ʃɪpt ˌɪˈliɡəli ɔr ˈʌndər ˈdubiəs ˈsɝkəmˌstænsəz frʌm dɪˈvɛləpt ˈneɪʃənz ˈlʊkɪŋ tu offload ðə ˈprɑbləm ˈtʃipli/

segments.text: And that practice creates devastating health and environmental hazards for the local populations living near these informal disposal or recycling sites. Right?
segments.ipa: /ənd ðæt ˈpræktəs kriˈeɪts ˈdɛvəˌsteɪtɪŋ hɛlθ ənd ɪnˌvaɪrənˈmɛntəl ˈhæzərdz fɔr ðə ˈloʊkəl ˌpɑpjəˈleɪʃənz ˈlɪvɪŋ nɪr ðiz ˌɪnˈfɔrməl dɪˈspoʊzəl ɔr riˈsaɪkəlɪŋ saɪts raɪt/

segments.text: People, sometimes including children, are often exposed to highly toxic substances while trying to scavenge for valuable materials to sell.
segments.ipa: /ˈpipəl səmˈtaɪmz ˌɪnˈkludɪŋ ˈtʃɪldrən ɑr ˈɔfən ɪkˈspoʊzd tu ˈhaɪli ˈtɑksɪk ˈsʌbstənsəz waɪl ˈtraɪɪŋ tu ˈskævəndʒ fɔr ˈvæljəbəl məˈtɪriəlz tu sɛl/

segments.text: It puts a very real, very human face on the problem.
segments.ipa: /ɪt pʊts ə ˈvɛri ril ˈvɛri ˈhjumən feɪs ɑn ðə ˈprɑbləm/

segments.text: It highlights deep issues of global waste trade and fundamental environmental justice.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈhaɪˌlaɪts dip ˈɪʃuz ʌv ˈɡloʊbəl weɪst treɪd ənd ˌfʌndəˈmɛntəl ɪnˌvaɪrənˈmɛntəl ˈdʒʌstəs/

segments.text: And while the material does note that local recycling initiatives are emerging in some of these regions,
segments.ipa: /ənd waɪl ðə məˈtɪriəl dʌz noʊt ðæt ˈloʊkəl riˈsaɪkəlɪŋ ˌɪˈnɪʃətɪvz ɑr ɪˈmɝdʒɪŋ ɪn sʌm ʌv ðiz ˈridʒənz/

segments.text: they often lack the proper infrastructure, safety regulations, and investment needed for truly sustainable recycling.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ ˈɔfən læk ðə ˈprɑpər ˌɪnfrəˈstrʌktʃər ˈseɪfti ˌrɛɡjəˈleɪʃənz ənd ˌɪnˈvɛstmənt ˈnidəd fɔr ˈtruli səˈsteɪnəbəl riˈsaɪkəlɪŋ/

segments.text: So, this case study really shows that the environmental cost of our consumption of technology isn't born equally across the world.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ðɪs keɪs ˈstʌdi ˈrɪli ʃoʊz ðæt ðə ɪnˌvaɪrənˈmɛntəl kɑst ʌv ˈaʊər kənˈsʌmpʃən ʌv tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ˈɪzənt bɔrn ˈikwəli əˈkrɔs ðə wɝld/

segments.text: It's often pushed onto the most vulnerable communities.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ˈɔfən pʊʃt ˈɑntu ðə moʊst ˈvʌlnərəbəl kəmˈjunətiz/

segments.text: That's a very accurate summary of the issue raised. Okay.
segments.ipa: /ðæts ə ˈvɛri ˈækjərət ˈsʌməri ʌv ðə ˈɪʃu reɪzd ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Beyond its societal and ethical impact, technology is also fundamentally reshaping the global economy and how nations interact.
segments.ipa: /bɪˈɑnd ɪts səˈsaɪɪtəl ənd ˈɛθɪkəl ˌɪmˈpækt tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ɪz ˈɔlsoʊ ˌfʌndəˈmɛntəli riˈʃeɪpɪŋ ðə ˈɡloʊbəl ɪˈkɑnəmi ənd haʊ ˈneɪʃənz ˌɪntərˈækt/

segments.text: Its economic and global reach is incredibly significant and still growing.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk ənd ˈɡloʊbəl ritʃ ɪz ˌɪnˈkrɛdəbli səɡˈnɪfɪkənt ənd stɪl ˈɡroʊɪŋ/

segments.text: Let's start with its role simply as an economic engine.
segments.ipa: /lɛts stɑrt wɪð ɪts roʊl ˈsɪmpli æz æn ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk ˈɛndʒən/

segments.text: Our material points to the massive influence of major tech companies.
segments.ipa: /ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl pɔɪnts tu ðə ˈmæsɪv ˈɪnfluəns ʌv ˈmeɪdʒər tɛk ˈkʌmpəˌniz/

segments.text: You know, the names giants like Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft as key drivers of economic growth and innovation on a truly global scale.
segments.ipa: /ju noʊ ðə neɪmz ˈdʒaɪənts laɪk ˈæpəl ˈæməˌzɑn ˈɡuɡəl ˈmaɪˌkroʊˈsɔft æz ki ˈdraɪvərz ʌv ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk ɡroʊθ ənd ˌɪnəˈveɪʃən ɑn ə ˈtruli ˈɡloʊbəl skeɪl/

segments.text: their market capitalization, their reach, it's enormous. Absolutely.
segments.ipa: /ðɛr ˈmɑrkət ˌkæpɪtəlɪˈzeɪʃən ðɛr ritʃ ɪts ɪˈnɔrməs ˌæbsəˈlutli/

segments.text: But the economic dynamism isn't just concentrated in these huge corporations, important as they are,
segments.ipa: /bʌt ðə ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk ˈdaɪnəˌmɪzəm ˈɪzənt dʒʌst ˈkɑnsənˌtreɪtɪd ɪn ðiz hjudʒ ˌkɔrpərˈeɪʃənz ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt æz ðeɪ ɑr/

segments.text: the material also emphasizes the crucial role of startups and smaller agile innovative companies,
segments.ipa: /ðə məˈtɪriəl ˈɔlsoʊ ˈɛmfəˌsaɪzəz ðə ˈkruʃəl roʊl ʌv ˈstɑrˌtʌps ənd ˈsmɔlər ˈædʒəl ˈɪnəˌveɪtɪv ˈkʌmpəˌniz/

segments.text: particularly in rapidly evolving sectors like fintech financial technology, creating new ways to pay,
segments.ipa: /ˌpɑrˈtɪkjələrli ɪn ˈræpədli ɪˈvɑlvɪŋ ˈsɛktərz laɪk fintech fəˈnænʃəl tɛkˈnɑlədʒi kriˈeɪtɪŋ nu weɪz tu peɪ/

segments.text: borrow, invest in edtech, educational technology, developing new digital learning tools.
segments.ipa: /ˈbɑˌroʊ ˌɪnˈvɛst ɪn edtech ˌɛdʒəˈkeɪʃənəl tɛkˈnɑlədʒi dɪˈvɛləpɪŋ nu ˈdɪdʒətəl ˈlɝnɪŋ tulz/

segments.text: These smaller players are often vital for job creation and for driving innovation within specific niches,
segments.ipa: /ðiz ˈsmɔlər ˈpleɪərz ɑr ˈɔfən ˈvaɪtəl fɔr dʒɑb kriˈeɪʃən ənd fɔr ˈdraɪvɪŋ ˌɪnəˈveɪʃən wɪˈðɪn spəˈsɪfɪk ˈnɪtʃɪz/

segments.text: contributing to a vibrant and evolving tech ecosystem.
segments.ipa: /kənˈtrɪbjutɪŋ tu ə ˈvaɪbrənt ənd ɪˈvɑlvɪŋ tɛk ˈikoʊˌsɪstəm/

segments.text: So, it seems technology doesn't just create a few big winners.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ɪt simz tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ˈdʌzənt dʒʌst kriˈeɪt ə fju bɪɡ ˈwɪnərz/

segments.text: It also fosters a wider culture of entrepreneurship.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈɔlsoʊ ˈfɑstərz ə ˈwaɪdər ˈkʌltʃər ʌv ˌɑntrəprəˈnɝʃɪp/

segments.text: It allows for new business models to emerge and potentially thrive, disrupting established players. Absolutely.
segments.ipa: /ɪt əˈlaʊz fɔr nu ˈbɪznəs ˈmɑdəlz tu ɪˈmɝdʒ ənd pəˈtɛnʃəli θraɪv dɪsˈrʌptɪŋ ɪˈstæblɪʃt ˈpleɪərz ˌæbsəˈlutli/

segments.text: This constant churn of disruptive innovation, often technology-led, is a key characteristic of modern economic dynamism.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ˈkɑnstənt tʃɝn ʌv dɪsˈrʌptɪv ˌɪnəˈveɪʃən ˈɔfən technology-led ɪz ə ki ˌkɛrəktərˈɪstɪk ʌv ˈmɑdərn ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk ˈdaɪnəˌmɪzəm/

segments.text: Technology platforms enable entirely new forms of commerce.
segments.ipa: /tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ˈplætˌfɔrmz ɛˈneɪbəl ɪnˈtaɪərli nu fɔrmz ʌv ˈkɑmərs/

segments.text: They connect businesses with customers globally in ways that were impossible before.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ kəˈnɛkt ˈbɪznəsəz wɪð ˈkʌstəmərz ˈɡloʊbəli ɪn weɪz ðæt wɝ ˌɪmˈpɑsəbəl bɪˈfɔr/

segments.text: And they facilitate entrepreneurship, sometimes with relatively low initial barriers to entry compared to traditional industries.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðeɪ fəˈsɪləˌteɪt ˌɑntrəprəˈnɝʃɪp səmˈtaɪmz wɪð ˈrɛlətɪvli loʊ ˌɪˈnɪʃəl ˈbæriərz tu ˈɛntri kəmˈpɛrd tu trəˈdɪʃənəl ˈɪndəstriz/

segments.text: Technology has also been a major force behind increasing globalization and economic interdependence.
segments.ipa: /tɛkˈnɑlədʒi hæz ˈɔlsoʊ bɪn ə ˈmeɪdʒər fɔrs bɪˈhaɪnd ˌɪnˈkrisɪŋ ˌɡloʊbəlɪˈzeɪʃən ənd ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk ˌɪntərdəˈpɛndəns/

segments.text: It facilitates crossborder communication, complex supply chain coordination and international trade at speeds and scales never before possible.
segments.ipa: /ɪt fəˈsɪləˌteɪts ˈkrɔsˌbɔrdər kəmˌjunəˈkeɪʃən ˈkɑmplɛks səˈplaɪ tʃeɪn koʊˌɔrdəˈneɪʃən ənd ˌɪntərˈnæʃənəl treɪd æt spidz ənd skeɪlz ˈnɛvər bɪˈfɔr ˈpɑsəbəl/

segments.text: in our material gives a fantastic often cited example of technology driving this kind of global connection and economic change sometimes in unexpected places.
segments.ipa: /ɪn ˈaʊər məˈtɪriəl ɡɪvz ə fænˈtæstɪk ˈɔfən ˈsaɪtəd ɪɡˈzæmpəl ʌv tɛkˈnɑlədʒi ˈdraɪvɪŋ ðɪs kaɪnd ʌv ˈɡloʊbəl kəˈnɛkʃən ənd ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk tʃeɪndʒ səmˈtaɪmz ɪn ˌʌnɪkˈspɛktɪd ˈpleɪsəz/

segments.text: Empasa in Kenya.
segments.ipa: /Empasa ɪn ˈkɛnjə/

segments.text: Ah yes, Empa.
segments.ipa: /ɑ jɛs Empa/

segments.text: It's a truly remarkable story and a classic case study launched in Kenya way back in 2007 by Safariccom.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ə ˈtruli rɪˈmɑrkəbəl ˈstɔri ənd ə ˈklæsɪk keɪs ˈstʌdi lɔntʃt ɪn ˈkɛnjə weɪ bæk ɪn baɪ Safariccom/

segments.text: Empa is essentially a mobile phone-based money transfer financing and micro financing service.
segments.ipa: /Empa ɪz ɛˈsɛnʃəli ə ˈmoʊbəl phone-based ˈmʌni trænsˈfɝ fəˈnænsɪŋ ənd ˈmaɪˌkroʊ fəˈnænsɪŋ ˈsɝvəs/

segments.text: Our material highlights how it absolutely revolutionized financial inclusion in Kenya and several other African countries.
